note: Audited findings that are accepted for now. This list may only shrink: when a check stops firing, delete its entry (tests/test_audit.py fails on stale entries). Anything not listed here is an unexpected finding and fails the audit and the kernel suite.

gaps.title: cap://software/git/operate has no implementation
gaps.detail: The compiler emits this capability for git/commit intents. No runtime claims it, so the executor reports the step 'unavailable' (never a fake success).
gaps.plan: Add a deterministic git runtime (bounded, fixed-argv git commands with a rollback point) or register it with an agent adapter that can operate a repository.
gaps.exit_criteria: Either the capability is satisfied by a registered resource (ontology capabilities.satisfied_by non-empty) or the compiler stops emitting it.

gaps.title: cap://research/web has no implementation
gaps.detail: Declared capability with no runtime; needs network access and a provider boundary.
gaps.plan: Wire the dormant model providers (saf/models) behind a research runtime with explicit network policy.
gaps.exit_criteria: A registered resource claims cap://research/web and the network policy is enforced and tested.

gaps.title: cap://interaction/browser has no implementation
gaps.detail: Declared capability with no runtime; browser automation is a §17 trust-pipeline concern.
gaps.plan: Browser adapter behind the sandbox/trust pipeline; do not register it before policy enforcement exists.
gaps.exit_criteria: A browser resource is registered with a tested policy boundary.
